implementation.scope: 6 L3 over one row-cutter domain: the Channel Builder trench through a stone row, the Micro Prong scallop row, the Bright Cut Channel along the row, the Bright Cutter around one gem, the channel profile/end controls and the multi-stone Interactive Boolean.
implementation.shared_input: the gem owner's om9.gem record and placement of every selected stone, in selection order; every selected closed mesh body that is not a gem and not an om9.cutter
implementation.shared_output: closed cutter meshes carrying om9.cutter (kind + row provenance) and, for a cut, each replaced metal body with om9.cutter.cut

limitations: Cutter bodies are closed mesh bodies built from rings and 4-corner sections, not B-Rep solids; the B-Rep swap is the kernel adapter's own gate.
The Interactive Boolean reuses the one mesh CSG service and requires a closed mesh target; a surface body is refused instead of silently meshed.

The manual text for the channel/bright pages is not in the repository, so the option names come from the L3 domain inputs and the manual's named controls (Height, Length, 2D Scale, Mirror, end profiles); each mapping is documented in the L3 api.md.
The manual gate M07-UI is not signed: the dashboard keeps the six L3 at WIP until a human reviews the window preview/commit/cancel.
